name: session_id
description: Rolling session identifier from epicstore_sid cookie. Primary key.

name: user_id
description: MongoDB ObjectId of the authenticated user (null for anonymous sessions)

name: anonymous_id
description: Long-lived anonymous identifier from epicstore_anon cookie

name: session_start
description: Timestamp of the first event in this session. Partition field.

name: session_end
description: Timestamp of the last event in this session (updated on session close)

name: page_views
description: Total number of page view events in this session

name: entry_page
description: URL path of the first page viewed in this session (landing page)

name: exit_page
description: URL path of the last page viewed before session ended

name: confidence_level
description: Attribution confidence level for this session

name: converted
description: True if a purchase occurred during this session

name: revenue
description: Total revenue from purchases in this session (0 if no conversion)

name: device
description: Device type for this session: desktop | mobile | tablet
